primary_instruments: GENIUS Act, Pub. L. 119-27; federal implementing proposals
current_stage_date: 2025-07-18 enacted; expected effective 2027-01-18 absent earlier final-rule trigger
issuer_permission: Federal + qualifying state pathways for permitted payment stablecoin issuers
reserve_backing: Statute requires at least 1:1 identifiable reserves in specified liquid assets; implementation rules still being finalised
redemption: Statute requires public timely-redemption policy; proposed federal rules further specify operational timelines
ongoing_supervision: Monthly reserve-composition disclosure and independent accounting examination/certification requirements in statute; AML/CFT implementation rules underway
critical_boundary: Do not label the federal regime 'in force' as of 2026-10-16

current_stage_date: ART/EMT provisions applicable since 2024-06-30; full MiCA framework implemented in 2024
issuer_permission: ART and EMT issuers require relevant authorisation; significant tokens face EBA-level supervision
reserve_backing: MiCA imposes reserve, custody, own-funds, liquidity and risk-management requirements by token category
redemption: Holder/redemption rights depend on ART vs EMT rules; redemption-plan requirements are applicable
ongoing_supervision: White paper, governance, complaints, reporting, recovery/redemption planning; 2026 MiCA review is ongoing but current rules remain applicable
critical_boundary: Do not treat the 2026 review consultation as suspension of MiCA

primary_instruments: FSMA 2000 (Cryptoassets) Regulations 2026; FCA PS26/10; BoE systemic-stablecoin framework
current_stage_date: Regulations made 2026-02-04; FCA final rules 2026-06-30; full commencement 2027-10-25
issuer_permission: FCA authorisation for qualifying-stablecoin issuance under future regime; systemic issuers also enter BoE/FCA joint framework
reserve_backing: FCA final rules set backing-asset/safeguarding requirements; systemic prudential layer handled by BoE
redemption: FCA final rules include redemption requirements; systemic rules add financial-stability constraints
ongoing_supervision: Disclosure, safeguarding, prudential, Consumer Duty/operational-resilience and systemic transition rules
critical_boundary: Do not say 'final rules pending'; do not say the full regime is already live

current_stage_date: Issuer regime effective 2025-08-01; first licences effective 2026-04-10
issuer_permission: Licence required for regulated fiat-referenced stablecoin issuance within scope
reserve_backing: High-quality/high-liquidity reserve assets; segregation, trust protection, risk management, regular independent assurance/audit
redemption: Licensed issuers must provide par redemption rights under the Ordinance/guidelines
ongoing_supervision: Governance, disclosure, technology risk, business continuity and AML/CFT supervision
critical_boundary: Licence does not by itself mean the licensee's token is already publicly launched

primary_instruments: MAS-SCS policy framework + proposed Payment Services Act amendments
current_stage_date: Policy design finalised 2023; implementation consultation 2026-09-01 to 2026-10-16
issuer_permission: Proposed MAS-SCS framework for SCS issued in Singapore and pegged to SGD or G10 currencies; only qualifying issuers may use MAS-regulated label after framework is in force
reserve_backing: Proposed/value-stability safeguards cover reserve composition, valuation, custody and audit plus capital/liquid assets
redemption: Policy design calls for par redemption within five business days
ongoing_supervision: Disclosure and user-protection requirements are part of proposed implementation
critical_boundary: Do not label XSGD/XUSD or existing DPT/MPI activity as issuance under a live MAS-SCS regime

primary_instruments: Payment Services Act electronic-payment-instrument regime + 2026 intermediary amendments
current_stage_date: Electronic Payment Instrument regime from 2023-06-01; new intermediary regime from 2026-06-01
issuer_permission: Electronic Payment Instrument Exchange Service Providers require registration; 2026 rules also permit registered intermediary models under stated conditions
reserve_backing: Backing/asset safeguards depend on the legal issuer form and applicable banking/funds-transfer/trust framework
redemption: Fiat-linked redeemability is central to the electronic-payment-instrument category; service rules protect customer assets/transactions
ongoing_supervision: Registration, customer protection, AML/CFT and travel-rule obligations apply
critical_boundary: Use Japan's statutory category 'electronic payment instruments'; do not invent a single generic stablecoin-issuer licence

jurisdiction_en: United Arab Emirates — CBUAE onshore perimeter
primary_instruments: CBUAE Payment Token Services Regulation C 2/2024
issuer_permission: Licences/registrations cover Dirham Payment Token issuance, custody/transfer and conversion; foreign-issuer registration is separately provided
reserve_backing: Reserve assets must be protected/segregated and at least equal outstanding face value; detailed cash/eligible-government-asset rules apply by issuer type
redemption: Tokenholders may request par redemption; licensed issuers must redeem without delay and generally by next business day
ongoing_supervision: Capital, reserve audits, customer agreements, AML/CFT and operational requirements
critical_boundary: This row is not a complete UAE-wide legal map; VARA, ADGM and DIFC are separate perimeters

issuer_permission: Virtual-currency related business remains illegal financial activity; no normal domestic private-stablecoin issuance/payment licensing path
reserve_backing: No dedicated prudential reserve regime for a normally authorised domestic private-stablecoin issuer because such activity is not opened as a standard licensed business
redemption: No domestic regulated public redemption framework for private stablecoins
ongoing_supervision: Payment-channel controls, AML/risk enforcement, restrictions on offshore service provision; approval required for offshore RMB-linked stablecoin issuance and offshore issuance by Mainland entities/controlled overseas entities
critical_boundary: Do not describe this as merely 'cautious' or 'framework pending'
